strings.zh: 大吾『传说在很久以前,{NEWLINE}有一群坏人在这片地区{CLEAR}干着烧光、杀光、抢光这样的恶行。{CLEAR}不堪暴行的人们指挥自己的精灵,{CLEAR}向坏人发起了保卫家园的正义战争。{SCROLL}大吾『当战争陷入胶着的时候,{NEWLINE}有三只柱型精灵{CLEAR}对坏人们使出了「大爆炸」招式,{CLEAR}以牺牲自己为代价{CLEAR}重创了坏人的大本营。{SCROLL}大吾『多亏了那场大爆炸{NEWLINE}关东的人们获得了宝贵的战略优势,{CLEAR}并最终赢得了战争、赶跑了坏人。{CLEAR}为了纪念这三只柱型精灵的牺牲,{CLEAR}人们从此尊称它们为{CLEAR}岩神柱、冰神柱、钢神柱。{CLEAR}并将它们的残躯埋在这座岩山隧道中。

strings.en: I really had nowhere left to hide, so I{NEWLINE}squeezed into this corner.{SCROLL}My friends are all smarter than me.{SCROLL}I bet they’re wearing all kinds of{NEWLINE}disguises!

strings.zh: 拜托你不要走！请帮帮我们！
strings.en: Please don’t go! Please help us!

strings.zh: 小豪『喂！弄得怎么样了？
strings.en: Goh: Hey! How’s it going?

strings.zh: 刚刚已经弄好了,{NEWLINE}石壁上破损的文字都被我修复了。
strings.en: All done just now. I’ve restored all the{NEWLINE}damaged writing on the stone wall.

strings.zh: 乔伊『那就请把石壁上的文字{NEWLINE}读出来给大家听听吧。
strings.en: Joy: Then please read the writing on{NEWLINE}the wall out for everyone.

strings.zh: 好的,乔伊小姐。
strings.en: Yes, Miss Joy.

strings.zh: 十四年以来,{NEWLINE}强盗闯我家园、夺我精灵、杀我同胞,{CLEAR}关东大地几无宁日。{CLEAR}万幸吾辈宁死不屈,{CLEAR}集万千训练家与精灵伙伴之力,{CLEAR}与强盗艰难周旋。{CLEAR}后有岩、冰、钢三神柱漂洋而至,{CLEAR}以牺牲自身之伟大爆炸,{CLEAR}将罪恶强盗扫灭大半。{CLEAR}至此强盗终作鸟兽散,{CLEAR}关东亦重归安宁。{CLEAR}今将三位伟大神柱之残躯埋藏于此,{CLEAR}立碑以纪念在对抗强盗战争中{CLEAR}牺牲的正义战士。
strings.en: For fourteen years, bandits invaded our{NEWLINE}homeland, seized our Pokémon and{CLEAR}slaughtered our people.{SCROLL}Kanto scarcely knew a day of peace.{SCROLL}Fortunately, our people would rather{NEWLINE}die than yield.{SCROLL}Gathering the strength of countless{NEWLINE}Trainers and their Pokémon partners,{CLEAR}we struggled hard against the bandits.{SCROLL}Then Regirock, Regice and Registeel,{NEWLINE}the three God Pillars, came from across{CLEAR}the sea.{SCROLL}With the great explosion that took{NEWLINE}their own lives, they wiped out most of{CLEAR}the wicked bandits.{SCROLL}At last the bandits scattered like birds{NEWLINE}and beasts, and Kanto was at peace{CLEAR}once more.{SCROLL}Here we lay to rest the remains of the{NEWLINE}three great God Pillars.{SCROLL}This stone stands in memory of the{NEWLINE}righteous warriors who gave their lives{CLEAR}in the war against the bandits.
strings.notes: Stone tablet (read aloud by the grunt). '十四年' = fourteen years (WWII allegory), kept literally. | RV002: grammar: 万幸吾辈宁死不屈 'By fortune' → 'Fortunately, our people'

strings.zh: 小豪『这都什么玩意儿？{NEWLINE}这就是复活三神柱的关键？
strings.en: Goh: What the heck is this junk?{SCROLL}This is the key to reviving the three{NEWLINE}God Pillars?

strings.zh: 呃,最后还有一行小字。
strings.en: Uh, there’s one more line in small print{NEWLINE}at the end.

strings.zh: 请来此碑前缅怀英雄的后人默哀静思。
strings.en: Those of later generations who come{NEWLINE}before this stone to honor the heroes{CLEAR}are asked to pause in silent tribute.
strings.notes: ext-review RA-014

strings.zh: 小豪『就这么多信息了？
strings.en: Goh: That’s all the info there is?

strings.zh: 是的,没有其他文字了。
strings.en: Yes. There’s no other writing.

strings.zh: 小豪『冥王的情报是不是有问题啊,{NEWLINE}这就是块纪念碑,{CLEAR}跟复活三神柱有什么关系。
strings.en: Goh: Is Charon’s intel bad or what? This{NEWLINE}is just a memorial stone.{SCROLL}What’s it got to do with reviving the{NEWLINE}three God Pillars?

strings.zh: 乔伊『或许默哀就是{NEWLINE}唤醒三神柱的方法呢？{CLEAR}我来默哀一下试试看吧。
strings.en: Joy: Maybe the moment of silence is how{NEWLINE}you wake the three God Pillars?{SCROLL}Let me try observing one.

strings.zh: 小豪『切,都是些不知道{NEWLINE}多少年前的死人和精灵了,{CLEAR}有什么值得默哀的。
strings.en: Goh: Tch. They’re just dead people and{NEWLINE}Pokémon from who knows how many years{CLEAR}ago. What’s there to mourn?
strings.notes: RV002: softened: Goh's blunt 死人 (dead people) restored

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小豪你这是加入火箭队了吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Goh, have you joined Team{NEWLINE}Rocket?

strings.zh: 小豪『怎么是你这个讨厌鬼。
strings.en: Goh: Oh, great. It’s you, you pain in{NEWLINE}the neck.

strings.zh: 乔伊『真是的,{NEWLINE}偏偏在解开谜题的关键时候。
strings.en: Joy: Honestly, right when we’re about{NEWLINE}to crack the puzzle.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我原本以为你只是个{NEWLINE}没有公德心的训练家,{CLEAR}没想到你居然与火箭队为伍了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I thought you were just a{NEWLINE}Trainer with no sense of decency.{SCROLL}I never imagined you’d team up with Team{NEWLINE}Rocket.

strings.zh: 小豪『我想要传说中的精灵,{NEWLINE}而火箭队能提供给我这个平台,{CLEAR}我们当然是一拍即合了。{CLEAR}我现在要跟火箭队一起推翻{CLEAR}精灵联盟这种{CLEAR}只会限制我自由的烂组织！
strings.en: Goh: I want legendary Pokémon, and{NEWLINE}Team Rocket can give me the platform to{CLEAR}get them. Of course we hit it off.{SCROLL}Goh: Now I’m going to help Team Rocket{NEWLINE}overthrow the Pokémon League, that{CLEAR}rotten outfit that does nothing but{CLEAR}limit my freedom!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我不会让你们这些人得逞的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I won’t let people like you get{NEWLINE}away with it.

strings.zh: 小豪『还是那副让人作呕的{NEWLINE}自以为是嘴脸啊。
strings.en: Goh: Still wearing that sickening,{NEWLINE}self-righteous face, huh?

strings.zh: 小豪『喂！你们两个给我上,{NEWLINE}先消耗一下这个混蛋。
strings.en: Goh: Hey! You two, get in there and{NEWLINE}wear this bastard down first.

strings.zh: 是！
strings.en: Yes, sir!
strings.notes: v3 TM retranslated

strings.zh: 联盟冠军是吧？
strings.en: The League Champion, huh?

strings.zh: 你去死吧！
strings.en: Drop dead!

strings.zh: 不行了。
strings.en: I’m finished.

strings.zh: 我们已经尽力了。
strings.en: We did all we could.

strings.zh: 乔伊『好了,你们退下吧。{NEWLINE}下面由我和小豪来对付这家伙。
strings.en: Joy: All right, you two, stand back. Goh{NEWLINE}and I will deal with this one.

strings.zh: 小豪『你应该也收集了不少精灵吧？{NEWLINE}等我把你打败之后,{CLEAR}就把它们全都抢过来！
strings.en: Goh: You must have collected plenty of{NEWLINE}Pokémon too, right? Once I beat you,{CLEAR}I’m taking every last one of them!

strings.zh: 小豪『可恶,已经没有战斗能力了,{NEWLINE}先撤退要紧。{CLEAR}穿洞绳！
strings.en: Goh: Dammit, I’m out of Pokémon that{NEWLINE}can fight. Gotta retreat first.{SCROLL}Goh: Escape Rope!

strings.zh: 乔伊『看到你越强大,我就越伤心……
strings.en: Joy: The stronger you get, the sadder{NEWLINE}it makes me...

strings.zh: 乔伊『咱们也别等了,撤退吧！
strings.en: Joy: No point waiting around. Let’s pull{NEWLINE}out too!

strings.zh: 石壁上似乎刻着一些文字,{NEWLINE}但因为岁月的侵损已经模糊不清了。
strings.en: Some writing seems to be carved into{NEWLINE}the stone wall, but the years have worn{CLEAR}it away until it can’t be read.

strings.zh: 十四年以来,{NEWLINE}强盗闯我家园、夺我精灵、杀我同胞,{CLEAR}关东大地几无宁日。{CLEAR}万幸吾辈宁死不屈,{CLEAR}集万千训练家与精灵伙伴之力,{CLEAR}与强盗艰难周旋。{CLEAR}后有岩、冰、钢三神柱漂洋而至,{CLEAR}以牺牲自身之伟大爆炸,{CLEAR}将罪恶强盗扫灭大半。{CLEAR}至此强盗终作鸟兽散,{CLEAR}关东亦重归安宁。{CLEAR}今将三位伟大神柱之残躯埋藏于此,{CLEAR}立碑以纪念在对抗强盗战争中{CLEAR}牺牲的正义战士。{SCROLL}请来此碑前缅怀英雄的后人默哀静思。{SCROLL}要默哀吗？
strings.en: For fourteen years, bandits invaded our{NEWLINE}homeland, seized our Pokémon and{CLEAR}slaughtered our people.{SCROLL}Kanto scarcely knew a day of peace.{SCROLL}Fortunately, our people would rather{NEWLINE}die than yield.{SCROLL}Gathering the strength of countless{NEWLINE}Trainers and their Pokémon partners,{CLEAR}we struggled hard against the bandits.{SCROLL}Then Regirock, Regice and Registeel,{NEWLINE}the three God Pillars, came from across{CLEAR}the sea.{SCROLL}With the great explosion that took{NEWLINE}their own lives, they wiped out most of{CLEAR}the wicked bandits.{SCROLL}At last the bandits scattered like birds{NEWLINE}and beasts, and Kanto was at peace{CLEAR}once more.{SCROLL}Here we lay to rest the remains of the{NEWLINE}three great God Pillars.{SCROLL}This stone stands in memory of the{NEWLINE}righteous warriors who gave their lives{CLEAR}in the war against the bandits.{SCROLL}Those of later generations who come{NEWLINE}before this stone to honor the heroes{CLEAR}are asked to pause in silent tribute.{SCROLL}Observe a moment of silence?
strings.notes: Same tablet as #82 + #85 + prompt. | RV002: meaning: 后人 = later generations who come to honor the heroes, as #85 (D-1673); 'By fortune' grammar fixed as #82

strings.zh: 黑暗中似乎传来一个声音——{SCROLL}你认为犯下罪行之人{NEWLINE}受到惩罚是应该的吗？
strings.en: A voice seems to come from the{NEWLINE}darkness...{SCROLL}Do you think those who commit crimes{NEWLINE}deserve to be punished?
strings.notes: #111-117: voice-in-the-dark questions with political allegory (unrepentant aggressors); faithful (D-0627). #113-115 are menu options.

strings.zh: 对所犯罪行拒不承认、{NEWLINE}甚至引以为傲,{CLEAR}并一直妄图卷土重来的罪人,{CLEAR}应该如何处理与它们的关系？
strings.en: Criminals who refuse to admit their{NEWLINE}crimes, who even take pride in them and{CLEAR}keep scheming to make a comeback...{SCROLL}How should we deal with them?

strings.zh: 尽弃前嫌,和平相处
strings.en: Forgive and forget

strings.zh: 认贼作父,俯首称臣
strings.en: Kneel to the bandits
strings.notes: 认贼作父,俯首称臣 (idiom: take the enemy as one's father) → 'Kneel to the bandits'; menu options kept short (≤20 chars) for the choice box.

strings.zh: 警觉提防,准备斗争
strings.en: Be ready to fight

strings.zh: 你认为外来的强盗{NEWLINE}能平等友善地对待当地人,{CLEAR}为当地人创造更好的生活条件吗？
strings.en: Do you think foreign bandits could treat{NEWLINE}the locals fairly and kindly, and give{CLEAR}them a better life?

strings.zh: 你认为今天的和平生活{NEWLINE}与过往英雄们的牺牲有关系吗？
strings.en: Do you think today’s peaceful life has{NEWLINE}anything to do with the sacrifices of{CLEAR}the heroes of the past?

strings.zh: 没有什么反映……
strings.en: There’s no response...

strings.zh: 背后好像有声音传来。
strings.en: A voice seems to come from behind you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}开始了默哀。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} began a moment of silence.

strings.zh: 默哀完毕,什么事都没有发生。
strings.en: The moment of silence is over. Nothing{NEWLINE}happened.

strings.zh: 岩神柱在上面庄严地看着你,{NEWLINE}要邀请它加入队伍吗？
strings.en: Regirock gazes down at you solemnly.{NEWLINE}Invite it to join your party?

strings.zh: 队伍已满,整理一下再来吧。
strings.en: Your party is full. Make some room and{NEWLINE}come back.

strings.zh: 我原来以为{NEWLINE}信号光线是照亮洞穴的技能,{CLEAR}所以就让我的精灵们拼命练习,{CLEAR}结果到最后却发现{CLEAR}闪光才是照亮洞穴的技能。{CLEAR}不过也多亏了最近的练习,{CLEAR}我已经熟练掌握{CLEAR}让精灵学会信号光线的方法了。{CLEAR}如果你肯给我一个黑暗球的话,{CLEAR}我就可以教会你的精灵信号光线。{SCROLL}怎么样,要学吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I thought Signal Beam was the move that{NEWLINE}lights up caves, so I had my Pokémon{CLEAR}practice it like crazy.{SCROLL}In the end, I found out Flash is the{NEWLINE}move that lights up caves!{SCROLL}Still, thanks to all that practice, I’ve{NEWLINE}mastered teaching Signal Beam.{SCROLL}If you give me one Dusk Ball, I can{NEWLINE}teach your Pokémon Signal Beam.{SCROLL}So, how about it? Want to learn it?{SCROLL}
